     state, kinematics, and real-time control symbols to the shared base. -->

## Physical AI Notation {.unnumbered}

Physical AI adds symbols for embodied state, rigid-body geometry, and real-time
control on top of the shared notation above.

## 1. Physical State and Dynamics

| Symbol                                                                           | Definition                                                               | Canonical Units                                           |
|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:-------------------------------------------------------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------|
| $s_t \in \mathcal{S}$                                                            | True physical state of the machine and environment at time $t$           | Mixed / Continuous                                        |
| $\mathbf{x} = [\mathbf{q}^\top, \dot{\mathbf{q}}^\top]^\top \in \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ | Full continuous mechanical plant state vector (positions and velocities) | $\text{rad, rad/s}$ or $\text{m, m/s}$                    |
| $o_t \in \mathcal{O}$                                                            | Sensor observation ingested by the computing pipeline                    | $\text{DN}$ (Digital Numbers) / $\text{V}$ / $\text{rad}$ |
| $a_t \in \mathcal{A}$                                                            | Actuator action command (e.g., target torque or joint setpoint)          | $\text{N}\cdot\text{m}$ / $\text{rad}$                    |
| $\mathbf{q} \in \mathbb{R}^n$                                                    | Generalized joint coordinate configuration vector                        | $\text{rad}$ or $\text{m}$                                |
| $\dot{\mathbf{q}} \in \mathbb{R}^n$                                              | Generalized joint velocity vector                                        | $\text{rad/s}$ or $\text{m/s}$                            |
| $\ddot{\mathbf{q}} \in \mathbb{R}^n$                                             | Generalized joint acceleration vector                                    | $\text{rad/s}^2$ or $\text{m/s}^2$                        |
| $\boldsymbol{\tau} \in \mathbb{R}^n$                                             | Generalized joint actuator torque/force vector                           | $\text{N}\cdot\text{m}$ or $\text{N}$                     |
| $\mathbf{M}(\mathbf{q})$                                                         | Generalized inertia / mass matrix                                        | $\text{kg}\cdot\text{m}^2$                                |
| $\mathbf{C}(\mathbf{q}, \dot{\mathbf{q}})$                                       | Coriolis and centrifugal force matrix                                    | $\text{N}\cdot\text{m}\cdot\text{s/rad}$                  |
| $\mathbf{g}(\mathbf{q})$                                                         | Gravitational generalized force vector                                   | $\text{N}\cdot\text{m}$                                   |
| $\mathbf{J}(\mathbf{q})$                                                         | Kinematic manipulator Jacobian matrix                                    | Mixed: $\text{m/rad}$ and dimensionless                   |
| $N$                                                                              | Transmission / gearbox reduction ratio ($N \gg 1$)                       | Dimensionless                                             |
| $N^2 J$                                                                          | Reflected rotor inertia seen at the gearbox output shaft                 | $\text{kg}\cdot\text{m}^2$                                |

---

## 2. Geometry and Spatial Transformations

| Symbol                                    | Definition                                                                            | Canonical Dimension                          |
|:------------------------------------------|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:---------------------------------------------|
| $SE(3)$                                   | Special Euclidean Group of 3D rigid-body poses ($\mathbb{R}^3 \times SO(3)$)          | Lie Group                                    |
| $SO(3)$                                   | Special Orthogonal Group of 3D rotational matrices                                    | $3 \times 3$ Orthogonal                      |
| $\mathbf{p} \in \mathbb{R}^3$             | Translation position vector $[x, y, z]^\top$                                          | $\text{m}$                                   |
| $\mathbf{R} \in SO(3)$                    | 3D rotation matrix ($\mathbf{R}^\top \mathbf{R} = \mathbf{I}, \det(\mathbf{R}) = +1$) | $3 \times 3$ Matrix                          |
| $\mathbf{q}_{\text{quat}} \in \mathbb{H}$ | Unit quaternion rotation representation $[w, x, y, z]^\top$                           | $\lVert \mathbf{q}_{\text{quat}} \rVert = 1$ |
| $\mathbf{T}_{A \to B}$                    | Homogeneous rigid transform mapping coordinates from Frame $A$ to Frame $B$           | $4 \times 4$ Matrix                          |
| $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}_{\text{depth}}$      | 3D spatial covariance matrix of perception depth estimate                             | $\text{m}^2$                                 |

---

## 3. Cognitive Deliberation and Policy Models

| Symbol                        | Definition                                                                  | Canonical Units           |
|:------------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------|:--------------------------|
| $\pi_\theta(a \mid o)$        | Parametric neural policy with weights $\theta$                              | Probability density       |
| $\mathbf{z} \in \mathbb{R}^d$ | Latent spatial-semantic representation vector                               | Dimensionless             |
| $H$                           | Action chunk temporal prediction horizon (e.g., $H=16$ or $H=32$)           | Discrete time steps       |
| $\mathbf{A}_{t:t+H}$          | Predicted action chunk trajectory vector $[a_t, a_{t+1}, \dots, a_{t+H-1}]$ | Sequence of actions       |
| $\mathcal{D}_{\text{demo}}$   | Dataset of nominal human/expert demonstrations                              | Sequence of tuples        |
| $\mathcal{D}_{\text{rec}}$    | Dataset of human recovery and intervention trajectories                     | Sequence of tuples        |
| $\epsilon_{\text{BC}}$        | Single-step imitation learning policy error rate                            | Dimensionless ($\le 1$)   |
| $O(T^2 \epsilon)$             | Compounding quadratic covariate drift error under open-loop policy rollouts | Cumulative error          |
| $\Lambda_{\text{intent}}$     | Expiring Intent Lease with bounded Time-To-Live (TTL)                       | Spatial-temporal contract |

---

## 4. Real-Time Control, Safety, and Enforcement

| Symbol                                                                     | Definition                                                                                     | Canonical Units                          |
|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------|:-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:-----------------------------------------|
| $\mathcal{C} \subset \mathcal{S}$                                          | Forward-invariant safe operating set                                                           | State space subset                       |
| $h(\mathbf{x}) \ge 0$                                                      | Continuously differentiable Control Barrier Function (CBF)                                     | Real scalar                              |
| $L_{\mathbf{f}} h(\mathbf{x}), L_{\mathbf{g}_{\text{ctrl}}} h(\mathbf{x})$ | Lie derivatives of the barrier along drift $\mathbf{f}$ and control $\mathbf{g}_{\text{ctrl}}$ | Real scalars                             |
| $\gamma_{\text{cbf}}$                                                      | Extended class-$\mathcal{K}$ barrier decay rate parameter                                      | $\text{s}^{-1}$                          |
| $u_{\text{nom}}$                                                           | Unprivileged nominal control action proposed by neural policy                                  | $\text{N}\cdot\text{m}$                  |
| $u^*$                                                                      | Verified, minimally-intervened control action emitted by CBF-QP filter                         | $\text{N}\cdot\text{m}$                  |
| $d_{\text{stop}}$                                                          | Dynamic stopping distance envelope                                                             | $\text{m}$                               |
| $v_{\max}, a_{\max}, j_{\max}$                                             | Maximum physical velocity, acceleration, and jerk limits                                       | $\text{m/s}, \text{m/s}^2, \text{m/s}^3$ |

---

## 5. Hardware Silicon and Electrical Budgets

| Symbol                    | Definition                                                                                                       | Canonical Units                 |
|:--------------------------|:-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:--------------------------------|
| $\text{BW}_{\text{mem}}$  | Main system memory bus streaming bandwidth                                                                       | $\text{GB/s}$                   |
| $M_{\text{weights}}$      | Neural policy total parameter model memory footprint                                                             | $\text{GB}$                     |
| $t_{\text{stream}}$       | Minimum memory streaming latency ($M_{\text{weights}}/\text{BW}_{\text{mem}}$)                                   | $\text{s}$ or $\text{ms}$       |
| $\Delta t_{\text{fresh}}$ | Physical freshness deadline for sensor ingestion                                                                 | $\text{ms}$                     |
| $t_{\text{lag}}$          | End-to-end sense-to-torque physical execution latency                                                            | $\text{ms}$                     |
| $f_{\text{ctrl}}$         | Inner reflex loop execution frequency (canonical: 1000 Hz)                                                       | $\text{Hz}$                     |
| $I_{\text{phase}}$        | Motor phase electrical current                                                                                   | $\text{Amperes (A)}$            |
| $R_{\text{phase}}$        | Electrical phase winding resistance                                                                              | $\text{Ohms } (\Omega)$         |
| $C_{\text{th}}$           | Stator thermal capacitance                                                                                       | $\text{J/K}$                    |
| $\Delta T$                | Joulean stator thermal rise ($\frac{I_{\text{phase}}^2 R_{\text{phase}} \Delta t}{C_{\text{th}}}$)               | $\text{Kelvin (K)}$             |
| $L_{\text{bus}}$          | Parasitic power distribution harness inductance                                                                  | $\text{Henries } (\mu\text{H})$ |
| $\Delta V$                | Inductive power rail dynamic droop ($L_{\text{bus}} \frac{dI_{\text{bus}}}{dt} + I_{\text{bus}} R_{\text{bus}}$) | $\text{Volts (V)}$              |
